subject.title: ClickClack discussion sidebars should follow the Control UI theme

question: Should OpenClaw adopt and maintain a stable, cross-origin theme-sync contract for ClickClack discussion embeds, coordinated with the active ClickClack PR?
rationale: The request adds a durable inter-repository iframe protocol with security and compatibility implications; source evidence shows a reusable host theme bridge, but the permanent public ownership and contract boundary require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the coordinated embed contract
options.body: Define the narrow initial-theme and validated live-update contract, then review the OpenClaw and ClickClack changes together.

options.title: Keep discussions independently themed
options.body: Retain ClickClack account appearance as the only source of truth and close the request as intentionally unsupported.

options.title: Limit synchronization to light and dark mode
options.body: Adopt a smaller contract that omits custom semantic palettes, trading visual fidelity for a reduced integration surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the coordinated embed contract
recommendation.body: Define the narrow initial-theme and validated live-update contract, then review the OpenClaw and ClickClack changes together.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the issue and are already driving the corresponding ClickClack implementation.
